jobs.title: Part-Time Teaching Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Our Team as a Teaching Assistant!

Salary: Up to £28,437 + excellent benefits

Working Days: Thursday 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM & Friday 8:30 AM - 4:00 PM

Celebrate the Huge Small Victories

At Witherslack Group, our Teaching Assistants thrive on making even the smallest positive changes in the lives of our young people. We believe in celebrating every achievement, no matter how small. For some of our students, simply sitting through a lesson is a monumental win. These huge small victories may seem minor, but they accumulate to create a significant impact!

Your Role

As a Teaching Assistant, you will work closely with children and young people who have Autistic Spectrum Disorder and Social, Emotional, and Mental Health needs. Your mission? To help them learn, develop their abilities, and boost their self-esteem. While the journey can be challenging, the rewards of witnessing their progress will fill you with pride.

About Hall Cliffe Primary School

Located in Wakefield, Hall Cliffe Primary School is an independent specialist day school dedicated to providing high-quality education for children with a range of special educational needs and disabilities. Here, you will support children who have faced trauma and adversity, helping them feel safe and valued through creative and adaptive teaching methods.

What We’re Looking For

We seek resilient and compassionate professionals who can create nurturing environments where children feel ready to learn. This role is challenging but incredibly rewarding, offering you the chance to make a genuine difference in the lives of our students.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:
  • Supporting children with Autism, SEMH needs, and communication differences.
  • Building trusting relationships to foster a safe learning environment.
  • Implementing creative and adaptive teaching strategies.
  • Celebrating and documenting the progress of our students.
What We Offer You

We recognize your hard work and commitment, and we reward you with one of the best salary and benefits packages in the education sector. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Training: Comprehensive induction and on-the-job training.
  • Holidays: Enjoy full school holidays to recharge.
  • Progression: Opportunities for career development, with many leaders promoted from within.
  • Flexible Benefits: Tailor your benefits to suit your needs.
  • Wellbeing: Access to wellbeing tools and employee assistance.
  • Medical Cover: Claim back costs for appointments like opticians and dentists.
  • Beautiful Work Environments: Work in well-resourced schools.
  • Referral Bonus: Earn £1,000 for every friend you recommend.
  • Pension: Contributory pension scheme matched up to 5%.
Bring Your Whole Self to Work

Our diverse workforce reflects the backgrounds and needs of our young people. You’ll connect with students through:

  • Your positive, can-do attitude as a team player.
  • Your passion for supporting children and making a difference.
  • Your enthusiasm to collaborate with teachers and therapists.
Ready to Make a Difference?

At Witherslack Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and valued. We celebrate individuality and champion diversity, especially in neurodiversity.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process or in the workplace, we’ll support you every step of the way.

Join us in building a diverse and inclusive team that can better support the children, young people, and families we serve. Together, we can ensure that every member of our team thrives and grows in their authentic selves.

Note: This position is subject to an enhanced DBS check, which we will cover the cost for. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer.
